gates.required_input: Execute a freshly prepared, current-epoch balanced Skill Lift denominator.
Run the locked denominator across at least three model families and compute paired confidence bounds.
Run the full harness at frontier scale with elapsed-time and unplanned-intervention telemetry.
Provide a durable private task root, author fresh non-public tasks, and submit the commitments to independent audit.
Produce real current-epoch run outputs for 24 tasks by 10 trials and pass package admission.
Recruit at least ten practitioners and ingest blinded judgments.
Have an independent auditor sample tasks and estimate the broken or ambiguous rate.
Observe real install-to-resolved-surface and seven-day behavioral reuse against 1.9.0.
Repeat the routing, single-owner edit, and same-route reverify contract with real model runtimes.
Calibrate the deterministic decision ledger, then admit bounded council dispatch only after unsupported auto-decisions remain at zero.

hard_pause_policy: When every unresolved gate requires non-local evidence, stop creating local patches and request only the smallest missing authority or resource.
